QUOTE: `force=True` skips the freshness check but never the source-staleness refusal (`stale_code_refusal`), and it reports `duration_ms` for the call.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the write path refuses on stale code ("A rebuild is refused") and that force skips the freshness check but never the stale-code refusal. That means a force flag cannot override the refusal. It also notes that auto-refresh is blocked when the process predates its source.
